Categories.value: Lace pillow|Lacemakers|Featured pictures of Malta|Self-published work|Images from Wiki Loves Folklore 2023|Malta photographs taken on 2012-05-19|Images from Wiki Loves Folklore 2023 in Malta|Human hands at work|Wrinkled hands|Images from Wiki Loves Folklore 2023 to check|Uploaded via Campaign:wlf 2023|Bizzilla|Featured pictures from Wiki Loves Folklore 2023

ImageDescription.value: Traditional Maltese Lace-making. Maltese lace is a style of bobbin lace made in Malta. The ancient craft of lace making (maltese ‘il-bizzilla’), became popular in Gozo around the mid 1840’s and is a style of bobbin lace made using silk or linen thread worked as a continuous piece onto a tall, thin, upright hard pillow called a ‘trajbu’ made from straw and paper.

Artist.value: Renata Apan
